result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: the bottom Popular card is clipped behind the tab bar hiding its details, and carousel content including a restaurant name and filter chip is cut off at the right edge.

issues.description: The second card under Popular right now (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom by the bottom tab bar. Its restaurant name, delivery time, and rating are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so the scrollable list ends above the Home/Search/Orders/Profile tab bar

issues.description: Third card in Fastest near you shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' with text clipped mid-word at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add end peek padding and use ellipsis truncation for carousel cards so names do not appear cut off mid-character

issues.description: Category filter row on the right edge shows a partially cut-off pill with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal end padding and fade or peek spacing to indicate the chip row is scrollable
